mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_TIME_TABLE ( ID , COURSE_ID , DATETIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT , TIME ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{courseId}, #{date}, #{agenda}, #{subject}, #{time} )
mapper.select: SELECT DATETIME , TIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY DATETIME ASC, TIME ASC
SELECT DATETIME , TIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND DATETIME >= #{date} AND DATETIME < #{date} + 1 ORDER BY TIME ASC
